name: Haifa · Galilee
tagline: Bahá'í terraces, crusader Acre and the Sea of Galilee
summary: A port city climbing Mount Carmel, home to the Bahá'í World Centre's terraced gardens. Crusader Acre, Nazareth and the Sea of Galilee are all within an hour. Check current travel advice before planning.
seasonNote: Mild spring and autumn; hot summers; wildflowers in March and April.
arrival: Trains from Ben Gurion Airport and Tel Aviv take about an hour.
gettingAround: The Carmelit funicular climbs the hill; trains and buses reach Acre and Nazareth; a car is easiest for Galilee.
foodTip: Arab cuisine in Wadi Nisnas and the German Colony; knafeh in Nazareth; fish by the harbour in Acre.
buyTip: Spices and sweets in Acre's market.
baseArea: The German Colony or the Carmel Centre

items.name: Bahá'í Gardens and Shrine of the Báb
items.summary: Nineteen terraces of gardens descending Mount Carmel to the golden-domed Shrine of the Báb, the holiest Bahá'í place after Acre.
items.expect: Free; the full terraces only by guided tour from the top; modest dress.
items.tip: Join the free English tour from the upper terrace and walk down to the German Colony.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult in local currency, not a live ticket quote; check current prices and what is included.
items.sourceNote: Editorial selection. Durations, spending allowances and itinerary advice are planning estimates; check opening days and prices with the venue before you go.
whyVisit: Nineteen terraces of gardens descending Mount Carmel to the golden-domed Shrine of the Báb, the holiest Bahá'í place after Acre.
A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the most beautiful gardens in the world.
visitFlow: Bus to the top of the terraces.
Guided descent, then the shrine and the German Colony.
items.bestFor: Visitors interested in sacred places and landscapes and wildlife
tradeoffs: Free; the full terraces only by guided tour from the top; modest dress.
